key_decisions: macOS torch goes to STABLE, same as Linux - the user's call: 'We can't rely on Nightly.' Measured before deciding.
Pinning a known-good NIGHTLY was rejected: PyTorch prunes old nightlies, so the pin would become an install failure.
The fix is darwin-only ON PURPOSE. Linux's unpinned-but-stable torch is the same class at far lower risk.
1.3.0 ALL THE WAY, NO BUMP - overwrite until right. 'If we have to do 300 builds, we do 300 builds.' (user)
